page.notes: The printed page is a title/dedication page with a few illegible stains at the bottom. "Nien-oordt" and "NON" (a Roman-style ligature, read as printed) are uncertain. "TARIIS" is probably a damaged "TARIIS" for "TARIIS" (Ordinum Potentium... Deputatis); the final word may be partially obscured. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
